# Power Automate Instructions (Draft)

Verify the installed, organization-approved Copilot client supports this instruction-file format before relying on automatic application.

- Specify trigger, conditions, inputs/outputs, error scopes, retry behavior, termination paths, concurrency, monitoring, owner, connection references, and environment variables.
- Never embed secrets. Prefer a local flow specification and mocked tests before environment work.
- Do not create, change, enable, disable, publish, delete, or resubmit a live flow without explicit approval; do not bypass DLP or environment controls.
